name: Globalization
overview: Scripture reveals that the global gathering of peoples from all directions into God's kingdom is a fulfillment of His sovereign plan, as seen in Luke 13:29 where individuals come from east, west, north, and south. This worldwide scope of salvation is grounded in God's immense love for the world, demonstrated by the giving of His Son so that all who believe may have eternal life (John 3:16). Amid this divine orchestration, believers are called to diligence and faithful stewardship rather than slothfulness, since neglect leads to wastefulness (Proverbs 18:9). The prophetic passages in Ezekiel 38:1 and Daniel 8:11 remind us of spiritual realities behind worldly powers, emphasizing God's ultimate authority over all nations and events.
